core_obligations: Construct the canonical map E tensor^L f_*O_X -> Rf_* Lf^* E as the mate under adjunction of the displayed composition Lf^*(E tensor Rf_*O_X) -> Lf^*E.
Reduce to the affine case: X = Spec(B) -> S = Spec(A) locally on S.
Compute there: Lf^*E = E tensor^L_A B and Rf_* is restriction of scalars, so Rf_* Lf^*E = E tensor^L_A B = E tensor^L f_*O_X as complexes of A-modules.
proof_roadmap: Adjoint-mate construction; affine localization; module-level identification.
difficulty_reason: The adjoint-mate construction plus one module-level affine computation; the localization is routine.
